title: Defects
summary: If your result on the table is found to be unfavorable or undesirable for reasons that are discomforting for you as a player, you are free to take the Calypso Body Defect directly neighboring the result you rolled.…
markdown:
If your result on the table is found to be unfavorable or undesirable for reasons that are discomforting for you as a player, you are free to take the Calypso Body Defect directly neighboring the result you rolled.

| d100 | Calypso Body Defect |
| --- | --- |
| 01-03 | Something about your appearance and the serial number on all of your pieces clearly marks you as Calypso-grown. Traditionalists and their like don't take kindly to the Calypso grown, but most transhumanists and technocults regard their presences as something fortunate. |
| 04-06 | The available bodies fail to fall within the acceptable margin of aesthetic error documented in your ScorchNET profile. Your appearance is totally randomized, but can be restored to what your previous body possessed with a week of complimentary physiotherapy. |
| 07-09 | One of your limbs wasn't properly sync'd with your engrammatic subjectivity backup. It feels a touch numb and sometimes appears as if it's acting of its own accord. Luckily, if nothing else, it does seem to understand that your survival is in its best interest. |
| 10-12 | A conspicuous barcode has been printed somewhere on your new body, and despite your best efforts, it seems to be irremovable. It means something to some corporation, organization, or well-off individual somewhere, but nothing to anyone else, or even you. |
| 13-15 | In certain lighting conditions, it's possible to see codescript written just beneath your skin or top mechadermal layer. Corpos and rebels all have very strong opinions about collecting free technoformulae, should you be willing to provide. Or in some cases, should you be unwilling. |
| 16-18 | A portion of your new body's nerve endings burn out with sympathetic echoes of your death and have to be replaced with cybernetics, or lower tier mechanics than you are used to. You now count as being significantly made of metal and gain the Robits and Bytes trait if you did not already have it. |
| 19-21 | Your Calypso body has especially sensitive components that react to ambient photoradiation. Protective components are cheap, but absorb light, and cause you to glow with dim light for a 5-foot radius when in darkness. You can suppress this trait for a minute with a bonus action. |
| 22-24 | A bug of the system, intentional or accidental, places you in the prepared body of a significantly more well-off individual, or at least some version of them. Their appearance more or less lines up with your acceptable margin of aesthetic error, but their friends might recognize them. If you so choose, change your upbringing feature to the "Don't I Know You?" feature from Fresh Clone. |
| 25-27 | Whenever you try to sleep or rest, vivid recollections of your previous body's demise flare up. Rejection sensitive phantom pain is common for a few months after inhabiting a new body, but for unfortunate cases like yours, it can linger for upwards of a year. |
| 28-30 | Genomechanical samples from bestial sources were used in your Calypso body's creation. You are often mistaken for a splicer, small kaijuborn, or the artificiate equivalent of either or, and certain impolite scientists treat you more like an experiment than a person. |
| 31-33 | Part of the resync software incorporating your engrammatic subjectivity backup into your body has been cobbled together with AI training software used by ScorchNET to organize the Calypso AIs. You gain the Systemic Obsession trait if you did not already have it. |
| 34-36 | Unfortunately, your new body had pseudoconscious sparks of thought before your engrammatic implementation. You are occasionally struck by a deep existential dread that you are merely a person with another individual's memories. Lived potential dysphoria pamphlets are available on your way out. |
| 37-39 | Calypso entertains many high-tier clients and your engram has been backended with a heavily encrypted software-depot. Certain people might be more inclined to keep you alive, while others might be more eager to kill you, should any become aware of this cache. |
| 40-42 | Your engrammatic subjectivity backup was corrupted and had to be partially reconstructed through your digital footprint. If you so choose, change your personality, ideals, buddies, quirks, and the skill proficiencies granted by your upbringing. |
| 43-45 | There were complications in the growing of your organic sources or the sourcing of your chassis. Your estimated life span is dramatically reduced by 2d20 years. Unless you plan to make this your last visit, your patronage of your local Calypso Clinic should make this a moot point. |
| 46-48 | Your nanites are improperly isolated from ambient nanointerference and you occasionally hear data packets shifting throughout the city. If you so choose, change your upbringing feature to the "Hear the Singing in the Wires" feature from Linerunner. |
| 49-51 | Your nanites act as a directional indicator for ambient nanointerference, subtly shifting the phase-state of the very air you may or may not breathe and the electrical signals of your body. You gain the Human Element trait if you did not already have it. |
| 52-54 | Something intercepted the live-update feed that updates your engrammatic subjectivity backup. You now share a telecommunicative network with an individual unknown to you, and statistics suggests that it's more likely to be a mountain dweller with a HAM radio rather than some dark, digital power. |
| 55-57 | Your Calypso body was not provided with the appropriate space for your engrammatic subjectivity, and you sometimes experience searing headaches and the brief loss of senses. During these periods, it is typical to imagine nonsensical visual stimuli or "visions." |
| 58-60 | Your Calypso body has been implanted with subliminal triggers that dictate you follow a pre-programmed course of action. Randomly determine a keyword and a simple course of action, such as attack, hide, or defend. This trigger can be easily removed with one week of complimentary psychotherapy. |
| 61-63 | Your engrammatic subjectivity backup's live-update was interrupted during your last run. The events immediately leading up to, involving, and following your previous death escape you. Some report this to be a boon, while for others, the very run in question leads to feelings of loss. |
| 64-66 | Your engram was intercepted upon its subjectivity recall and hollowed out by a very opportunistic virus, the constituent pieces of which now cause occasional issues with your body. You gain the Norton's Nightmare trait if you did not already have it. |
| 67-69 | Your visual cortex and topography references haven't been fully updated. Wherever you look, you cannot shake the sensation as if everything has been somehow subtly shifted two more inches to the left than it should be. Despite lasting disorientation, no tactical negative feedback has been observed from such a feeling. |
| 70-72 | Your engrammatic subjectivity backup's live-update hasn't been properly streaming since your last check up, and a great deal of your life has to be relayed to you secondhand or downloaded from procedural estimations of your runs. If you so choose, change your upbringing. |
| 73-75 | Someone had their local media player open and was enjoying a classic binge when your engram recall pinged through their device, beaming at least five seasons worth of a mecha-tokusatsu romp of musical delight directly into your head. If you so choose, change your upbringing feature to the "Otakubabble" feature from Weeb. |
| 76-78 | Your engram was touched by software—most likely spam—during it's recall and you find the world to be hysterically funny and giggle at the simplest things. When you must be silent, these giggles can be barely held back, but you become especially squirmy. |
| 79-81 | Your liver was misgrown or your synthtaste buds are overtuned making you especially sensitive to states of inebriation. You find yourself physically intoxicated by the lightest of substances and find such states to persist much longer than would be expected. |
| 82-84 | The subrealm that hosted your engrammatic subjectivity backup's live-update was in the middle of instancing and reformatting itself when your engram was recalled, leaving your memories a disoriented mess of self-referential moments. You gain the Canned and Banned trait if you did not already have it. |
| 85-87 | The parts of your brain-equivalent that convert short-term memory to long-term memory are… spotty at best. Wires and neurons crossed the wrong way. Every twelve hours, you forget the last 1d3 hours of your life. We recommend recording your runs. |
| 88-90 | Your digestive enzymes or the performatory equivalent of them have been overtaken by flights of unhealthy fancy. You can only gain the nutritional benefits of a meal if the meal is made primarily of candies and sweets. |
| 91-93 | A poor, overworked sap was running support when your engrammatic subjectivity sync found its place within your body and tried to awaken you with a screen-read of their latest corpo-congressional essay rather than the proper Calypso awakening manifest. If you so choose, change your upbringing feature to the "Institutional Memory" feature from Corporate Historian. |
| 94-96 | You are unable to bridge the gap between the "you" who died and the "you" of now. There is no existential dread or question of who was who, you are certain of the difference, and refer to yourself in the third person, as if narrating the old "you's" continued story. |
| 97-99 | We aren't quite sur—D̵i̴d̷ ̸y̴o̶u̸ ̶n̴o̵t̵ ̶e̴n̸j̸o̶y̵ ̸y̸o̵u̸r̷ ̷t̸i̸m̴e̴?̴—e what happened, but please acce—T̶h̵e̴ ̶y̸e̸a̴r̵s̶ ̸i̴n̶ ̶t̶h̴e̵ ̵w̸a̵s̶t̸e̸ ̶w̷i̸t̵h̵ ̵u̷s̷?̴—pt our humblest apolog—Y̶o̷u̸ ̴w̴i̸l̸l̵ ̷n̵e̴v̶e̵r̸ ̶b̸e̸ ̷w̴i̶t̷h̶o̴u̶t̸ ̴u̸s̵ ̶a̸g̵a̶i̶n̵.̵—ies. You gain the Rootkit of Denial trait if you did not already have it. |
| 100 | No defect, actually. Hang ten! |
